environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Split.io workspace 'prod-us-east-1' has the flag 'ldap-legacy-lookup-path' configured with default treatment 'off' and kill switch engaged since 2024-09-15. The flag definition has a prerequisite dependency on 'migration-rollback-active' which is also 'off'. Split's impression listener logs all evaluations to Datadog. The local cache file at SPLIT_CACHE_PATH is mounted from an EFS volume managed by a GitOps pipeline (ArgoCD) that reconciles the cache state every 30 seconds from the Split CDN relay proxy, ensuring the treatment cannot drift from the workspace definition. The relay proxy configuration specifies 'ldap-legacy-lookup-path' in its allowlist with enforced treatment 'off' and the proxy runs with READ_ONLY_MODE=true preventing any API-based override. Container runs with read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) except for the EFS mount which is managed externally.

config.efs_reconciliation: ArgoCD GitOps, 30s sync from Split CDN
